measures.title: Clay County Constitution Amendments
measures.summary: The Constitution Review Commission recommended several amendments to the Clay County Constitution. They would require a general election even when only one candidate files, move the power to nominate board and commission members and to appoint the Presiding Commissioner pro tem from the Presiding Commissioner to the full County Commission, let the Commission call special meetings, give commissioners the same benefits as other county employees, set the Prosecuting Attorney's salary at a Circuit judge's level and the Sheriff's at an Associate Circuit Judge's level, expand the County Administrator's authority as approved by the Commission, and let each commissioner appoint one member of the Re-Districting and Constitution Review Commission.
measures.yesMeans: Clay County adopts the proposed amendments to its county constitution.
measures.noMeans: The Clay County Constitution stays as it is.
